scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @tevrox/web lint && pnpm --filter @tevrox/mobile lint && uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.format:backend: uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
